title: How to Make Viral 3D Cutaway Videos With AI (No Blender, No Editing)
title_options: How These 3D "How It Works" Videos Are Made (Step by Step)
I Made a Viral-Style 3D Cutaway Video in Minutes, No Animation Skills
description: The 3D "see inside how it works" videos are everywhere right now. Here is exactly how to make one with Zyvo's Cutaway Explainer, step by step: no Blender, no animator, no editing.

facts.text: The premade topics on the page: Landfill, French drain, Swimming pool, Car wash
facts.source: the Cutaway page's PREMADE TOPICS chips (as recorded on screen)

facts.text: Premade topics are 30 seconds; custom topics 30 or 60 seconds
Sound effects: digging, drips, engines and a chime on each name
facts.source: the Cutaway page's sound effects switch

facts.text: Script: a fact-checked script and an energetic voiceover. Scene: the 3D cutaway is built, and every part appears on its word. Render: one continuous vertical video with captions and sound.
facts.source: the Cutaway page's How it works box

facts.text: The French drain video took 4 min 48 s from start to finished video

beats.say: These 3D videos, where you see inside how something works, are all over TikTok and YouTube right now.

slot.show: 2–3 of YOUR finished Cutaway videos playing, quick cuts (e.g. the car wash, then the swimming pool)

beats.say: Every part pops in right as it's named, in one smooth shot.

slot.show: 2–3 of YOUR finished Cutaway videos playing, quick cuts (e.g. the car wash, then the swimming pool)

beats.say: Making one by hand means modeling every pipe and every layer of dirt in Blender, or paying an animator. That's days of work.
I made mine with no coding and no editing.
And they work. You have probably scrolled past a few of these today.

slot.show: viral cutaway videos in a feed (yours or a credited creator's), scrolling

beats.say: So here's exactly how to make one, step by step.
Step one: head to tryzyvo.com.
Open your browser, type tryzyvo.com, and you're on the home page.

slot.show: your browser: type tryzyvo.com in the address bar, press Enter, the home page loads

beats.say: Step two: sign up.
Sign up at tryzyvo.com, and answer its quick onboarding questions.

slot.show: click Sign up, create the account, then answer the onboarding questions one by one

beats.say: A few clicks, and you are in.
Step three: click Short Form, then Cutaway Explainer.
It's in the menu on the left. Short Form, then the Cutaway Explainer card.

slot.show: from the home page: click Short Form in the left menu, then the Cutaway Explainer card; the Cutaway page opens

beats.say: Zyvo is made for people who are tired of animating everything themselves.
Normally, a video like this means days in Blender, or hiring an animator.
Its templates are built to make the same style of videos you keep seeing all over your feed.
Step four: type your topic, or pick a premade one.
Type anything that works underground or inside a building, like how a septic tank works.

slot.show: the Topic box: type "How a septic tank works" slowly, then clear it, then click the premade chips Landfill, French drain, Swimming pool and Car wash one by one

beats.say: Or tap one of the premade topics: Landfill, French drain, Swimming pool, or Car wash.

slot.show: the Topic box: type "How a septic tank works" slowly, then clear it, then click the premade chips Landfill, French drain, Swimming pool and Car wash one by one

beats.say: Then pick the length. Premade topics are thirty seconds, and custom topics can be thirty or sixty.

slot.show: the Length setting (point at 30 seconds), then the Sound effects switch: turn it on

beats.say: And turn on sound effects: digging, drips, engines, and a chime on every part as it's named.

slot.show: the Length setting (point at 30 seconds), then the Sound effects switch: turn it on

beats.say: Step five: hit Generate, and Zyvo starts cooking it.
First it writes a fact-checked script and records the voice.

slot.show: click Generate, then the progress screens in order: Writing the script → Building the 3D scene → Rendering one continuous shot

beats.say: Then it builds the 3D scene, so every part appears right on its word.

slot.show: click Generate, then the progress screens in order: Writing the script → Building the 3D scene → Rendering one continuous shot

beats.say: And it renders the whole thing as one continuous vertical video, with captions and sound.

slot.show: click Generate, then the progress screens in order: Writing the script → Building the 3D scene → Rendering one continuous shot

beats.say: My French drain video took just under five minutes, start to finish.
Step six: once it's done, your result will look something like this.

slot.show: one of YOUR finished Cutaway videos, full length, playing with its own sound

beats.say: Download it, and it's ready to post.

slot.show: the finished video in Zyvo: click Download

beats.say: So that's it: go to tryzyvo.com, sign up, open Cutaway Explainer, pick your topic, and hit Generate.
The link is in the description. Subscribe for more, and tell me in the comments which topic you'd make first.

voice.name: Alex - Upbeat, Energetic and Clear (male, American, entertainment)
